title: Satisfaction of GPs with their working conditions in Germany
summary:
The aim of this study is to find out how satisfied general practitioners are with their jobs, what causes them the most stress at work, and why they might consider changing their current position.
This information is important because many regions already have too few general practitioners, and this shortage is expected to worsen as many doctors reach retirement age. Previous studies have also shown that burnout symptoms among doctors can lead to poorer treatment outcomes.

interventions.name: In the period 01.06.22 to 31.12.22, an online questionnaire on general questions and on the family situation, on the general professional and special GP situation, on satisfaction with GP professional life as well as the Maslach Burnout Inventory will be collected.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
General practitioners, residents
Exclusion criteria:
Study employees
